<p class="section-intro">Applied economics work spanning household welfare, finance, and macroeconomic relationships.</p>

## Selected research experience

The following summaries reflect projects listed in my CV. Papers, datasets, and numerical results are not yet published here.

### Out-of-pocket healthcare expenditure and household welfare in Nigeria
**Tools:** Python and Stata · **Data:** household survey data

Conducted quantitative research involving data sourcing, cleaning, variable construction, analysis, interpretation, and reporting. Examined the relationship between healthcare expenditure and household welfare and translated statistical evidence into policy-relevant findings.

### Green finance and technological innovation
**Tools:** EViews and Stata · **Scope:** ECOWAS panel study

Sourced, restructured, cleaned, and validated multi-country data. The project involved ARDL, DOLS, GMM, PMG, and VECM approaches, diagnostic assessment, and interpretation of empirical results.

### Public debt and economic growth in Nigeria
**Tools:** EViews · **Approach:** time-series analysis

Prepared Nigerian macroeconomic data, estimated an ARDL model with bounds testing, and interpreted short-run and long-run relationships.

## Research support

During my time at Lagos State University, I contributed to 25 undergraduate research projects through literature review, design, collection, analysis, interpretation, and policy recommendations. These were support contributions, rather than a claim of 25 independently authored papers.
